bullets.text: In Chennai, a road cave-in on Velachery Main Road halted traffic before Diwali, and the office should monitor repair works.

In Chennai, the 22-km Padi-Thiruninravur stretch faces severe traffic congestion as the six-lane widening project remains a non-starter.
In Chennai, L&T's Vyoma.AI began construction of a 52 MW AI data centre, reinforcing the city's digital growth.
MeitY launched the DEPA handbook to support safe data sharing for AI training, which the office should review.
In India, rising demand for artificial intelligence and cloud computing is pushing data centre capacity towards 2 GW in 2026.
In Chennai, the Global Startup Summit 2026 will bring founders and investors together at Holiday Inn Chennai OMR IT Expressway on November 14.
